rules.name: spades_only

rules.name: different_suit_same_color
rules.description: The card must be of a different suit than but same color as the card just before it. Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1]
return card.color == prev.color and card.suit.suit_name != prev.suit.suit_name
